verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official MCP server plus 'agent skills' and a CLI designed for coding agents, letting AI agents translate natural-language instructions into Stripe API calls (create payments, refunds, sandboxes, etc.), which effectively enables natural-language operation via an AI agent intermediary. However, this is agent/API-mediated rather than a native NL interface inside Stripe's own product, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming real-world reliability of these NL-driven workflows. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of MCP/agent workflows actually working end-to-end, and any first-party conversational/NL interface built directly into Stripe's dashboard or product itself.
